subject: general
question: In electrolytic refining procedure, the cathode is made up of:
solution:
The correct answer is __**pure metal**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Pure metal:**
 
• In electrolytic refining, the cathode is made of a thin strip or rod of the pure metal that is to be refined.
 
• During electrolysis, metal ions from the electrolyte solution are attracted to the cathode.
 
• These ions gain electrons and are deposited as pure metal atoms onto the cathode.
 
• The cathode thus grows in size as pure metal accumulates on it.
 
• This process allows for the production of highly pure metals.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Impure metal:**
 
• The impure metal is used as the anode in electrolytic refining.
 
• At the anode, the impure metal undergoes oxidation, releasing metal ions into the electrolyte solution.
 
• Impurities that are more reactive than the metal being refined dissolve in the electrolyte.
 
• Impurities that are less reactive fall to the bottom as "anode mud."
 
• Therefore, the impure metal is used at the anode, not the cathode.
 
• **Alloy metal:**
 
• Alloy metals are mixtures of two or more metals.
 
• Alloys are not used as the cathode in electrolytic refining because the goal is to obtain a pure metal.
 
• Using an alloy would defeat the purpose of the refining process.
 
• Alloys are often the starting material for metals that need to be refined.
 
• An alloy is not a pure substance.
 
• **Metal salt:**
 
• A metal salt is used as the electrolyte in electrolytic refining.
 
• The electrolyte solution contains ions of the metal that is to be refined.
 
• The metal ions in the electrolyte are reduced at the cathode, forming pure metal.
 
• The metal salt provides the necessary ions for the electrolytic process.
 
• The metal salt is not the material that the cathode is made from.
